pages.title: Shades
text: The dead of the March walk where they died: an empty hood with two lights in it, and a robe with nothing under it. Every shade has **25 health** and no armour, and hits for **5**, but each fights its own way.
Each drops **1 to 2** of its reagent, more with Looting. None of them will bond.

pages.title: Barrow Shade
text: A crowned dead king in grave wraps. It haunts the dark caves under the Highlands, day or night, one or two at a time. Its blow weakens you for 4 seconds.
It drops **Barrow Shrouds**, a Weaken reagent.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Bones and up to 1 Phantom Membrane.

pages.title: Pale Wraith
text: An icy wraith trailing long veils. It flies over the Snow Fields at night, one or two at a time. From up to 12 blocks away it casts a chill that slows you for 3 seconds. Cover breaks the cast.
It drops **Wraith Veils**, a Chill reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Phantom Membrane and up to 2 Snowballs.

pages.title: Cinder Shade
text: A smouldering wraith with charred hands. It flies over the Ember Wastes at night, one or two at a time, and is **immune to fire**. From up to 12 blocks away it casts a bolt that sets you alight for 2 seconds. Cover breaks the cast.
It drops **Shade Embers**, a Bolt reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Phantom Membrane and a one-in-three chance of Blaze Powder.

pages.title: Drowned Shade
text: A weed-hung wraith carrying a lantern. It rises in the water of the Shallows at night, one or two at a time. Its blow weakens you for 4 seconds.
It drops **Drowned Weed**, a Weaken reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Phantom Membrane and up to 2 Prismarine Shards.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting.
